why: A versioned secret is the most common class in the inventory: 7 of the 16 videos. This is the cheapest slice of it, one `git ls-files`. The fail side has a tracked `.env`; the pass side has `.env.example` AND `.env.sample` tracked, which are the FIX for the failure and not the failure -- documenting the variables without the values is exactly what is asked for. Whoever removes the example exclusion makes the pass side go red; whoever swaps the check for "a .env exists on disk" makes the fail side go green, because a `.env` ignored by git is no finding at all.
